āyāga.g: āyajitabbo, tato tato āgamma vā yajitabbametthātipi āyāgo, deyyadhammānaṁ adhiṭṭhānabhūtoti vuttaṁ hoti.

Āyāgo.g: sabbassa sadevakassa lokassa aggadakkhineyyatāya deyyadhammaṁ ānetvā yajitabbaṭṭhānabhūto.

Āyāgavatthūnī.g: puññakkhettabhūtā aggadakkhiṇeyyā pathabyā puthū brāhmaṇā saṁvijjanti.

Āyāgavatthūni.g: puññakkhettabhūtā aggadakkhiṇeyyā pathabyā puthū brāhmaṇā saṁvijjanti.
